headline: Medford schools assessment landscape report and graduation requirements update, including alignment with state council recommendations.
summary: Dr. Kim Talbot will present an assessment landscape report. She will also give an update on graduation requirements.
items: Assessment landscape report by Dr. Kim Talbot, Assistant Superintendent for Academic & Instruction
Presentation of findings on assessments across the district
Graduation requirements update by Dr. Kim Talbot, Assistant Superintendent for Academic & Instruction
Review of Medford Public Schools' alignment with K-12 Statewide Graduation Council recommendations
